description: Needs a rent.dev account: sign in when your client offers it, or call rent_signup first. For someone who runs a machine, their own or a VPS rented elsewhere, and wants to sell its compute; to get a machine to use, call rent_create_sandbox instead. The payouts to your nodes, newest first: node, amount in micro-USD (USDC base units), network, token, the wallet paid from, the address paid to, and the transaction once known. `node` keeps one node's payouts. `state` is `open` until the finalized chain shows the transfer made (`paid`) or its last authorization expired unused (`void`; its earnings go into a later payout). `reason` says why a payout is void, or what the last send was refused with. To check a payout without trusting rent.dev, `eth_call` its `verify` (`to`, `data`) on any RPC of its network: the token answers 1 once the payout landed. `nonce` is the authorization's nonce the token accepts once. Each node is paid once a day, in USDC, to the address registered on that node; a node without an address is not paid and its releasable earnings wait until one is registered. A payout cannot be reversed, and a payout made is never sent again to another address. `next_cursor` is only for the next call of this tool.

node.description: Only this node's payouts: its id (`n` and 15 characters) from rent_supply_nodes. Another account's node, or an unknown id, gives an empty page.

name: rent_supply_payouts

next_cursor.description: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

title: List your payouts
